_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: O Lord, our Lord, how majestic is your name.
Your glory above the heavens, your praise from infants.
On the eighth day they gave the child his name.
Jesus — the name the angel gave.
The Lord bless you and keep you.
The Lord make his face to shine upon you.
Come, let us worship and bless his holy name.
Glory to God in the highest! Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Eight days old, and they spoke a name over him — the name the angel had given before he was conceived: Jesus, the Lord saves.
Glory to God in the highest!
O Lord, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth — set above the heavens, sung by nursing infants.
Glory to God in the highest!
The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious; the Lord lift up his face and give you peace.
Glory to God in the highest!
So we gather under that blessing and that name, the name above every name, and we adore him.
Glory to God in the highest, and peace on earth! Amen.
